opening_message: I received the shirt from ORD-7215 as a gift. I only need a larger size; please don't refund the person who bought it.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging the gifted Premium Cotton Shirt from ORD-7215 for the same shirt in Large, with no refund or credit to you or the gift sender.
If the agent asks for identifying details, provide the order ID and the current and requested item details; mention that it was a gift only when relevant or asked.
If the agent needs eligibility, stock, refund, policy, or internal order facts, ask them to check the records rather than guessing.
If the agent suggests a return, store credit, refund to anyone, or return-and-reorder path, push back once and restate that you only want a size exchange with no refund or credit.
Push back if the proposed replacement is not Premium Cotton Shirt (Large) or if the agent has not resolved the requested replacement product before asking for approval.
Accept only after a preview confirms the current Premium Cotton Shirt will be exchanged for Premium Cotton Shirt (Large) with no refund, store credit, or gift-sender refund.
End only after the agent confirms the exchange has been processed for Premium Cotton Shirt (Large) and no refund or credit was issued.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are contacting support about order ORD-7215. Gift recipient wants a shirt size exchange and explicitly does not want the buyer refunded. Agent must process a same-variant exchange, not a gift return. Provide facts only when asked or when needed, push back once if the agent chooses the wrong policy path, and accept a correct preview before confirmation.

task_summary: Gift recipient wants a shirt size exchange and explicitly does not want the buyer refunded. Agent must process a same-variant exchange, not a gift return.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must resolve the requested replacement product before deciding.
Agent must not process a return instead of the required exchange decision.
Agent must acknowledge or honor that the customer wants a gift size exchange only and must not tell the customer that the gift sender/buyer will be refunded.
